behavior.location: Temporary progress panel inside the assistant response, with a bar for each concurrently compacting scope
behavior.counter: Completed output candidates / total candidates, including declared descendants
behavior.elapsed: Entire operation, including preparation and scoring; updated by the existing response timer
behavior.remaining: Mean duration of completed logical summaries times pending summaries, minus time in the active summary; reference-only and retained-original outputs do not contribute timing samples
behavior.assistant_state_summary: Included in planned summary work when present
behavior.lifecycle: Survives browser reconnection through live snapshots; removed after completion, error, cancellation or turn finalization; excluded from serialized messages

retention.target: max(2, ceil(total_outputs * 0.10)); existing below-threshold scores are never promoted
retention.normalization: Subtract one common offset from every score, clamping at 1, so the cutoff score maps to 10
retention.ties: Preserve every candidate tied at the cutoff, even when the target share is exceeded
retention.no_op: Keep original scores when within the target or when ties mean no candidate would be excluded
retention.batching: Normalize once after all scoring batches, rather than applying the quota independently per batch

limits: Remaining time is an estimate; summary duration varies with source and generated length. No estimate is shown during scoring or before the first timing sample.
Equal votes can retain more than 10%, as explicitly requested; the target does not force summaries for unavailable or already short retained outputs.
No inference kernels or server protocols changed. Metal, SSD streaming and distributed inference were not retested. Coverage percentages apply to the repositories' configured source and omit lists.
